chapter_goal: Use finite and sampled models to test topological spaces, bases, continuity, Hausdorffness, countability, and local Euclidean manifold conditions.

items.inspection_target: which points are topologically distinguishable and which pairs cannot be separated
items.validation: all listed open families satisfy or fail topology and Hausdorff predicates as recorded

items.inspection_target: where a missing smaller basis element breaks the basis axiom
items.representation: good and bad basis witness graph
items.validation: good basis generates a topology; bad basis has a named refinement violation

items.inspection_target: checking preimages of basis elements detects the same pass/fail as checking all opens
items.representation: finite preimage table for two maps
items.validation: basis criterion agrees with full continuity for both sample maps

items.inspection_target: which hypotheses feed continuity, countability, separation, and manifold conclusions
items.representation: directed graph of definitions and consequences
items.validation: graph contains the three manifold inputs: Hausdorff, second countable, locally Euclidean

items.inspection_target: how neighborhoods on a curved space become open intervals or half-lines in coordinates
items.representation: interactive circle and interval chart panels
items.validation: sampled circle chart inverse residual is below numerical tolerance

items.inspection_target: which single missing hypothesis prevents a candidate from being a manifold
items.validation: finite Hausdorff zero-manifold agrees with discreteness; boundary-only interval is separated

items.inspection_target: full disk, half-space, and branching local neighborhoods have different direction signatures
items.representation: directional probe around disk, half-disk, and branch point
items.validation: direction interval counts distinguish interior, boundary, and branch probes
